extraction.name: EuroSAT
extraction.description: We present a novel dataset based on Sentinel-2 satellite images covering 13 spectral bands and consisting out of 10 classes with in total 27,000 labeled and geo-referenced images.
extraction.creator: Patrick Helber, Benjamin Bischke, Andreas Dengel, Damian Borth
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Satellite images of European cities were gathered and downloaded via Amazon S3.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Images taken by the Sentinel-2A satellite.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Bands with lower spatial resolution were upsampled using cubic-spline interpolation.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Images were manually checked to sort out mislabeled images and images full of snow or ice.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Images were manually checked and corrected to ensure ground truth accuracy.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset and classification system can assist in urban area development, nature protection, and sustainable development, such as detecting deforestation.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The dataset has not received atmospheric correction, which can result in images with a color cast.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Detecting land use and land cover changes and assisting in improving geographical maps.

name.evidence: The geo-referenced dataset EuroSAT is made publicly available at https://github.com/phelber/eurosat.

description.evidence: We present a novel dataset based on Sentinel-2 satellite images covering 13 spectral bands and consisting out of 10 classes with in total 27,000 labeled and geo-referenced images.

url.evidence: The geo-referenced dataset EuroSAT is made publicly available at https://github.com/phelber/eurosat.

rai:dataCollection.evidence: We gathered satellite images of European cities distributed in over 34 countries... We have downloaded satellite images taken by the satellite Sentinel-2A via Amazon S3.

rai:dataCollectionType.evidence: We have downloaded satellite images taken by the satellite Sentinel-2A via Amazon S3.

rai:dataCollectionRawData.evidence: We have downloaded satellite images taken by the satellite Sentinel-2A via Amazon S3.

rai:dataManipulationProtocol.evidence: Bands with a lower spatial resolution have been upsampled to 10 meters per pixel using cubic-spline interpolation [8].

rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol.evidence: We manually checked all 27,000 images multiple times and corrected the ground truth by sorting out mislabeled images as well as images full of snow or ice.

rai:dataAnnotationProtocol.evidence: We manually checked all 27,000 images multiple times and corrected the ground truth by sorting out mislabeled images as well as images full of snow or ice.

rai:dataSocialImpact.evidence: The presented examples are particularly of interest in urban area development, nature protection or sustainable development. For instance, deforestation is a main contributor to climate change, therefore the detection of deforested land is of particular interest (e.g., to notice illegal clearing of forests).

rai:dataLimitations.evidence: Please note, the proposed dataset has not received atmospheric correction. This can result in images with a color cast.

rai:dataUseCases.evidence: We demonstrate how this classification system can be used for detecting land use and land cover changes and how it can assist in improving geographical maps.
